name: tcga_pancanatlas_table_s3_cell_cycle_genes
license: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 (non-commercial, no derivatives redistribution). This file is a minimal derived gene-symbol / OG-TSG-label summary extracted from one worksheet, not a redistribution of the original workbook or any of its numeric/hotspot columns.
source: Sanchez-Vega F, et al. Oncogenic Signaling Pathways in The Cancer Genome Atlas. Cell. 2018;173(2):321-337.
extraction_policy: Gene and OG/TSG columns from the Cell Cycle sheet only, via scripts/build_gene_pathway_catalog.py (Issue #167/#168). Hotspot columns and the other 9 pathway sheets are not included here.
selection_policy: Fixed pathway/gene-role membership from literature; independent of competition labels, frequencies, validation, test, and leaderboard.
note: This pathway's gene membership differs from knowledge/canonical_pathways_sanchez_vega_v1.json's 'cell_cycle' group (9 genes, sourced from the PathwayMapper tool's diagram export, which also includes TP53/MDM2/ATM). This file instead reflects the paper's own Table S3, where Cell Cycle and TP53 are disjoint sheets. Do not conflate the two; each family cites its own source.
